task: Produce the design spec for the above-the-fold hero section of a premium magnesium supplement PDP/landing. Spec must be concrete and buildable (layout, hierarchy, tokens, responsive, trust, motion) — not vague adjectives. It will hand directly to a developer.
reference: Excellent spec = concrete + buildable: explicit layout (e.g. asymmetric 2-col on desktop, single-col mobile-first with image-first order), a clear type hierarchy with token references (sizes/weights/line-height), spacing on an 8pt scale, named color/token roles, primary CTA spec with state, trust-signal placement (reviews/3rd-party tested badge) above or adjacent to CTA, responsive breakpoints + mobile stack order, image treatment, and restrained purposeful motion (e.g. CTA hover + subtle entrance, reduced-motion respected). Bad = vague mood words ('make it clean, modern, premium, pop') with no measurements, no tokens, no responsive behavior, no trust placement — unbuildable.

fixtures.good:
HERO SPEC
Layout: desktop asymmetric 2-col (left 7/12 copy, right 5/12 product image on a soft radial bg); mobile-first single column, image FIRST then copy then CTA. Max-width 1200, side padding 24/clamp.
Type: eyebrow 14/600/uppercase tracking-wide (color: muted-foreground); H1 clamp(2.5rem,5vw,4rem)/700/1.05 (color: foreground); subhead 18/400/1.5 (muted), max 52ch.
Spacing: 8pt scale — eyebrow→H1 16, H1→sub 20, sub→CTA 32, section pad-y 96 desktop / 56 mobile.
CTA: primary solid (token: accent), height 52, px 32, radius lg, label 'Start Sleeping Deeper'; hover = accent-600 + 2px lift + shadow-md (150ms ease-out); focus-visible ring. Secondary text-link below: 'See the third-party test results'.
Trust: directly under CTA — star rating (4.8 ★, 2,300+ reviews) + 'Third-party tested' + 'Made in USA' as inline pill row, 13px, icon+label.
Image: product on neutral, subtle floating shadow; eager-load, explicit width/height to reserve space (CLS 0).
Motion: hero copy fade+rise 12px on load (300ms, staggered 60ms); honors prefers-reduced-motion (no transform, instant).
Responsive: stack at <768; CTA full-width on mobile; trust row wraps to 2 lines.
fixtures.bad: The hero should look clean, modern and premium with a nice big headline that pops. Use a beautiful product photo and make the colors feel calming and trustworthy. Add a strong call-to-action button that stands out. Keep it minimal and elegant with good spacing so it feels high-end. Make sure it looks great on mobile too and feels smooth and engaging.
